name: Tokyo Disney Resort restaurant Priority Seating
intro: Priority Seating is Tokyo Disney Resort's restaurant booking system. Park restaurants open one month ahead at 10:00 Japan time, and Disney Hotel restaurants three months ahead. A booking shortens your wait for a table but is not a fixed table time.

facts.bookAhead: One month for park restaurants, from 10:00 on the same date a month before; three months for Disney Hotel restaurants

statusNote: Read from the official Tokyo Disney Resort Priority Seating pages. They don't say what happens for dates that don't exist a month earlier (such as the 31st); we assume the park ticket rule, the 1st of the next month.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: many Disney visitors book a restaurant, but fewer search for it than for park tickets or Disney hotels.
difficultyNote: Estimate, not measured: the official pages don't say how fast tables fill. Same-day bookings are still offered online and at the restaurant, so we don't rate it as selling out in minutes.
bookingSteps: Create a user ID (account) for the Tokyo Disney Resort Online Reservations & Tickets site or the Tokyo Disney Resort App.
Park restaurants: book from 10:00 Japan time one month before the day you want to dine, until 20:59 the day before.
Disney Hotel restaurants: book from 10:00 Japan time three months before, until 60 minutes before your meal. Chef Mickey is the exception: it opens one month before.
Book for up to 8 people. One user ID can hold up to 3 advance bookings for the same day.
Pay at the restaurant on the day.
Arrive on time. Your booking may be cancelled if you arrive late.
visitorTips: Priority Seating is not a fixed table time. You may still wait, and parties of 5 or more may be seated separately.
Same-day bookings open online at 9:00 Japan time, and in person at the restaurant from 10:00 while seats last.
Groups of 9 or more must split into two bookings under two user IDs.
Cancelling a Disney Hotel reservation also cancels the dining bookings made with it.
Dates that don't exist a month earlier (such as March 31): the official pages don't say. We assume they open on the 1st of the next month, as park tickets do.

soldOut.label: Try again on the day: same-day bookings open online at 9:00, and at the restaurant from 10:00
Park tickets: on sale two months ahead

faq.q: When can I book a Tokyo Disney restaurant?
faq.a: For park restaurants, from 10:00 Japan time one month before the day you want to dine, until 20:59 the day before.

faq.q: How far ahead can I book Disney Hotel restaurants?
faq.a: Three months, from 10:00 Japan time, until 60 minutes before your meal. Chef Mickey opens one month before.

sources.quote: Booking in advance: From 10:00 a.m. (JST) one month before to 8:59 p.m. (JST) the day before you wish to dine.
Booking on the Day of Visit: From 9:00 a.m. (JST)
From 10:00 a.m. (JST) three month before to 60 minutes before you wish to dine.
Chef Mickey can be booked from 10:00 a.m. (JST) one month before to 60 minutes before you wish to dine.
